name: ASL Upgrade Operation
brief: ASL Fishing Operation Management System - Shipping/Fishing Industry ERP Extension
description: Business Central extension for ASL Fishing Operation Management System. Includes vessel operations management, payroll system with custom overtime calculations, inventory & procurement workflows, electronic invoice/credit memo export (Excel & XML), and enhanced dashboard interface. Features e-invoicing compliance, sea catch recording, AGO consumption tracking, store requisition workflows, and LS Retail integration.
